{{Quote|Your mission became entangled in an elaborate Imperial plan of deception and misdirection. However, the information you have given us is an added victory for the Alliance.|Admiral Gial Ackbar to Keyan Farlander|<ref name="TFP" />}}
The '''Battle in the Turkana system''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] attack against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] corvette [[Talon (Imperial corvette)|''Talon'']] near [[Turkana/Legends|Turkana]]. It was [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander's]] first mission. The Rebels captured the corvette and a copy of a top secret Imperial document.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Do we take the transport when we leave, destroy it, or abandon it?''"<br />"''Carry out the mission objectives and retreat immediately. We want as few casualties on this mission as possible. And we don't want any complications. Just hit hard, hit fast, and get out!|Captain Charger and Admiral Gial Ackbar|<ref name="TFP" />}}
[[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] agents noticed that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was taking precautions to make ''Talon'' look unimportant and that it actually contained important cargo, though whether this was information or a passenger was unclear. However, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] himself was known to be on the move and it was believed that he may, possibly, have been onboard. They also learned that it would be traveling to [[Celanon City]] with a skeleton crew and would have minimal escort. It was scheduled to be making a brief stop near [[Turkana/Legends|Turkana]].

==The Battle==
{{Quote|Storm Leader to all units. Any of you X-wing jockeys got a spare R2?|Storm Leader to the Rebel pilots|<ref name="TFP" />}}
[[File:Talon1.jpg|thumb|left|280px|''Talon'' comes under attack from Rebel forces.]]
The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] put together a strike force to attack the ship. The attack was led by the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigate]] [[Liberator (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Liberator'']], supported by [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] from [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red]] and [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue]] Squadrons and [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] from [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]]. Involved in the attack were [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Charger (captain)|Charger]] and [[Cadet/Legends|Cadet]] [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]], flying his first mission as wingman to [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Hamo Blastwell]] in Red Squadron.

[[File:Farlander_Shooting.jpg|thumb|200px|Farlander boarding the ''Talon'']]

While Blue Squadron's X-wings assisted ''Liberator'' in engaging defending [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]], the Y-wings used their [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] to disable ''Talon''. The ship was then boarded by [[Storm Unit (team)|Storm Unit]] with Red Squadron protecting their [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|transport]] from any TIEs that made it past Blue Squadron. Needing an extra [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2 unit]], Storm Unit asked if any pilots had one to spare. While Storm Unit fought against defending [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], Farlander and [[R2 (Keyan Farlander)|his R2 unit]] worked their way to the bridge where they deactivated any remaining turbolaser batteries and began downloading data from the ship's computer. He also relieved the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] of some disks which he was attempting to destroy, killing the officer in the process, before leaving the ship.

In order to make a quick escape before Imperial reinforcements could arrive, the Rebels left ''Talon'' where it was.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Let me show you what your heroism has recovered for us. It's an Imperial Military Specifications report. Ultra Top Secret.|Mon Mothma to Keyan Farlander|<ref name="TFP" />}}
Although Vader had not been aboard, the documents recovered proved to contain important information. These documents included a copy of the top secret Imperial document, ''[[Technical Specifications: Spacecraft of the Imperium and the Rebel Alliance]]'', detailing specifications of both Imperial and Rebel spacecraft and providing the Rebels with insight into the enemy's strengths and weaknesses.

After the mission, Keyan Farlander met [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] and [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] who made him a lieutenant for his heroism during this mission which happened only thirteen days after he had joined the Rebellion.

A simplified version of the mission was later ported to a [[Flight simulator/Legends|holosimulator]] for training for young pilots.
